description: Simple power-map model: P_elec = eta * P_thermal * load_factor. Helium-cooled, high-efficiency gas reactor.

unit.name: Generic Pebble-Bed HTGR (HTR-PM class)
unit.source: Zhang et al. (2009) Nucl. Eng. Des. 239:2265; Dong (2011) Nucl. Eng. Des. 241:4755

P_thermal_mw.note: Thermal power at full load (2 x 250 MW modules + margin)

eta_thermal.note: Net electrical efficiency (He Brayton/Rankine at 750C outlet ~47%)

T_out_degC.note: Helium outlet temperature at rated power

load_min.note: Minimum stable power fraction (pebble-bed design limit)
